release_blockers.title: Mobile bridge disable-path force-stop is asynchronous, not synchronous as the code's own security-invariant comment claims
release_blockers.evidence: Identical failure at the same assertion in two independent full 25-minute suite runs; passes reliably in isolation (low thread contention). Root cause confirmed by direct source read: handle() dispatches self.stop() to a daemon thread via threading.Thread(...).start() and returns the 503 response without joining it.
release_blockers.practical_exposure: narrow - LAN-only, opt-in, off by default, most routes still require a valid pairing token
release_blockers.smallest_fix: make the force-stop synchronous (direct self.stop() call, or a short join) before returning the 503
